professionalSummary.text: Candidate has three years of experience as an Analytics Engineer on the marketing data warehouse of a consumer software company.
professionalSummary.witness: Analytics engineer on the marketing data warehouse of a consumer software company for three years, building and maintaining the warehouse's transformation models under the modelling framework's standard; about ninety models in the period, each on a merge request in my name.

experienceHighlights.text: Candidate reviewed marketing analysts' model contributions and mentored analysts new to the framework through onboarding sessions.
experienceHighlights.witness: Reviewed the marketing analysts' model contributions as one of the team's two reviewers and mentored the analysts new to the framework through the onboarding sessions; the review records and the onboarding attendance for eleven analysts are in the repository, with the analysts' first merged contributions logged against their onboarding.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Candidate ran daily data quality checks and resolved their failures under the data quality procedure.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Ran the data quality checks each day and resolved their failures under the data quality procedure, with the failure log recording each resolution.

skills.text: Candidate coordinated model releases through the release checklist and ensured approval was granted by the analytics engineering lead.
skills.witness: Coordinated model releases through the release checklist; the release approval was the analytics engineering lead's, recorded on the checklist together with which checks were mine.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish the candidate's experience in building and maintaining transformation models, reviewing and mentoring analysts, running data quality checks, coordinating model releases, and documenting model limitations. They do not establish the candidate's ability to mentor without putting people off, as noted in the interviewer's note.

decisionBoundary.statement: The materials establish the candidate's technical qualifications for the role but raise concerns about their mentoring style based on the interviewer's note.
